title: Network Bulletin: Extra Days for Reactivated Cash Pickups After Out-of-Cash Refusals
content:
When Cash Pickup payout locations have refused a transfer's pickup because they had no cash, the network adds days to the window of a reactivated pickup on that transfer.

| Pickups refused on the transfer because the payout location had no cash | Days added to the reactivated window |
|---|---|
| two or more | 7 |
| exactly one | 4 |
| none | none |

Refusals for any other reason do not count. Those reasons are a name on the ID that does not match, an expired ID, no valid ID shown, and a wrong Pickup Number. The days are whole calendar days and move the reactivated pickup's last day of collection later by the same number.

## Hypothetical refusal histories

- One refusal because the location lacked cash, and two for an expired ID: one counts, so 4 days.
- Three refusals because the location lacked cash: 7 days.
- No out-of-cash refusal: no days.
